input.prompt:
Create ONE complete finished 3200x1440 game screen in the EXACT approved visual system of Image1. Image1 is our approved 风暴怕死队-style battle master. The user approved this direction: preserve its hanging-page tabs, enlarged hand-drawn resource icons, letterforms, palette, timber/brass frames, slot surfaces, item art, contour weight and spacing. Supporting official screenshots establish the same UI family; do not copy their game text or mechanics.

Keep the shared header pixel positions and scale. Exactly three tabs 装备栏位 / 英雄属性 / 装备图鉴; change only the selected tab as this page requires. Top right remains 生命180/180 full, 体力100/100 full, 腐化0/100 EMPTY, 金币4. Preserve the master's LARGE icons and numbers; never shrink them. All body text must be clear at phone scale: preferably at least56px, important numbers64px. Keep Chinese typography consistent with Image1.

Unless the page explicitly replaces the left+central area with a wide sheet, preserve BOTH side panels from Image1: 战斗装备 and 背包, matching top, bottom, width, title baseline and all four card rows. Both use ONE COLUMN of full-width horizontal cards, never split cells. Default left cards: green vial8/1, pale mushroom4 only, silver dagger30/2 with one purple enchantment mark and EMPTY0/100; fourth locked. Default right: three empty full-width cards and bottom locked. Page-specific ownership changes below override only those stated rows. Names/descriptions do not appear permanently on the equipped side cards.

Only the central page content, contextual title and authorized states/actions change. Use the approved hand-inked, warm brown/ochre UI with simple colored item art; no new art style, generic dark CSS boxes, photoreal metallic bevels, copied source-game branding, keyboard hints or developer placeholders. Selected controls and buttons should share the official game's warm amber/green-corner visual language and readable cream lettering. One primary task/action; align all bottom actions, with quieter secondary action at the left and primary at right. Remove battle aiming instructions on non-battle pages. Do not invent game features, fees, resources or extra controls beyond the page spec. Render the ENTIRE final screenshot with all art, labels and numbers in the image model.


PAGE10 MERCHANT SELL, BEFORE TRANSACTION. Use the GENERATED PURCHASE PAGE as the exact central structure and merchant identity reference. Keep header, tabs, item/detail positions, typography and button baselines. Local 出售 selected, 购买 inactive. First global tab remains selected.
OWNERSHIP: move the ONE existing 凝血毒剂 from left equipment row1 into RIGHT BACKPACK ROW1. Left row1 becomes EMPTY, with no vial or8/1 badges. Left row2 mushroom4 and row3 dagger30/2/0/100 remain unchanged. Right row1 contains the vial with8/1; right rows2/3 empty, bottom locked. Do not show a second physical vial as merchant stock. Central large icon is only the selected bag item's detail view.
Show name 凝血毒剂; status 背包物品; exact effects:
相邻物品造成伤害时，额外在3回合内造成8流血伤害。
相邻物品被认为是流血物品。
Clear price row 出售所得 1金币. Main action 出售 · 获得1金币. Secondary 离开商店. Current gold remains4, bag item remains present; no success toast or gold5. The value1 is the authorized visual-example sale price, not a claim that recycle price and sale price are always equal. Do not print this explanation or any placeholder in the screen. No purchase price shown in this sell view.
